title: About Zatas
description: We transform ideas into digital products that impact millions of people around the world
history: Zatas' journey began when a personal trainer, recommended by other programmers, contacted one of the partners, Bruno, looking for a way to optimize his student management. With this proposal in hand, Bruno invited Gabriel and Antony to collaborate on the application's development.

The project was a success and showed the team the power of collaboration. To complement the group's technical skills, Bryan was invited to the partnership, bringing his expertise in marketing and design.

Zatas was founded on this foundation: the union of diverse skills with the purpose of offering complete solutions. The company started by solving a specific problem and today continues with the same passion for turning each client's challenges into successful projects.

The name 'Zatas' was chosen for its strong and memorable sound. It refers to the word 'exact', reflecting the essence of the company's work: the search for precision, logic, and data intelligence in the construction of each solution. Zatas is synonymous with the exact solution for each client's challenge.

strategicDesc1: At Zatas, we combine design, development, and marketing to transform ideas into a solid digital presence. We work with companies that understand that positioning is not a detail — it is strategy.
strategicDesc2: Whether building an identity from scratch, developing a high-performance website, or structuring digital campaigns, our focus is simple: creating intelligent, well-executed, and result-oriented solutions.
commitmentFooter: We don't believe in exaggerated promises. We believe in strategy, method, and continuous evolution.
serviceDescriptions: Strategic institutional website. Complete development with a focus on performance, strong visual identity, and structure designed for conversion.
Complete solution developed tailored to your needs, consisting of a mobile application and robust integration.
Rebranding and digital positioning. Creation of a modern and consistent identity, aligning communication, online presence, and brand strategy.

Strategic print design. Development of graphic materials such as business cards, stationery, and institutional pieces with a strong visual identity, professional finish, and communication designed to generate credibility and impact.
Strategic campaigns focused on positioning, lead generation, and sales increase. Complete planning with creatives, segmentation, and performance analysis to maximize results.

historyParagraphs: Zatas was born from the union of professionals with complementary skills and a common vision: to develop intelligent and strategic digital solutions.
Throughout the first projects, we grew together, strengthened our experience, and decided to raise our level of operation, structuring the company in a professional and result-focused way.
Today, Zatas transforms challenges into complete solutions, uniting technology, design, and strategy.
